use default

strip_block_comments(
    text: string, start: string, ended: string
) -> string is
    let result mut = ""
    let pos mut = 0

    while pos < text.length do
        let open = text.index_of(start, pos)

        if open < 0 then
            result = "{result}{text[pos..<0]}"
            pos = text.length
        else
            result = "{result}{text[pos..open]}"

            let close = text.index_of(ended, open + start.length)

            pos = if close < 0 then text.length
                  else close + ended.length fi
        fi
    od

    result
